A dog from one of Argentina's Top breeders: Patricia Hazán (SPARKLING BEAR'S). She arrived at our home on April 9, 2005. We imported her from Argentina to introduce the best American lines into our breeding program.

From the cross of one of the most highly awarded Bobtails in South America (Sparkling Bear's Blue Steel) with a female descended from Argentina's Top Bobtails (Power Dog Eclipse and Sparkling Bear's Harmony Hill), closely linebred to Lambluv Premiere Performance (descended from the best Bobtails in the United States).
She is a female with a very distinctive, super-compact outline, an outstanding neck and an outstanding back. Her angulation and shoulders are excellent. Her head is incredibly large.

I thank her breeders Patricia and Dante (of the kennel "Sparkling Bear's") for entrusting us with this beautiful female, for their knowledge of OES and for sharing such good times despite the distance.
Mother of our litters I and J.
